Moving rightward, the Washington Examiner described "socialist hopes that come crashing down," and National Review characterized the results as "Democrats Choose Socialism." Fox News reached the furthest right, labeling progressive candidates guilty of "radicalism" they "can't erase" and accusing unnamed actors of "far-left meddling" — language that shifted from descriptive reporting into pointed ideological accusation.
